_nota: Banco de opciones. 'es' = etiqueta en español para el resumen; 'en' = texto que entra en el prompt. 'solo_escenas' limita una opción a esas escenas. Las ids 'extra' son añadidos nuevos a las del prompt original.

prioridad.en: POSE — body language is the showstopper: a bold, sculptural, highly dynamic pose with distinct body levels and irresistible charm.
MOVEMENT — capture a decisive moment mid-motion: swirling skirts, flying ribbon, hair in motion, a sense that the frame was caught a split second before something happened.
CAMERA ANGLE — the viewpoint itself is the spectacle: an unexpected, daring vantage point that makes the image instantly memorable.
FRAMING — an extraordinary, deliberate crop and frame-within-a-frame design that guides the eye in a surprising way.
FASHION — the period wardrobe is breathtaking: impeccably tailored, richly detailed 1950s garments photographed like a couture holiday campaign.
FABRIC — the textiles steal the show: satin sheen, velvet pile, crisp taffeta, chunky knits, tulle petticoats, all rendered with tactile, macro-level realism.
HAIR — the hair is sculpted and luminous, every curl, wave and strand catching the light with salon-perfect 1950s craftsmanship (natural hair color strictly preserved).
MAKEUP — period makeup is the hero: flawless 1950s technique on real, textured skin, beautifully lit and photographed close enough to appreciate it.
ACCESSORIES — jewelry, gloves, ribbons and festive details are the focal point, styled with jewel-box precision.
LIGHTING — the light is cinematic and extraordinary: sculpted, layered, motivated by practical sources and absolutely gorgeous.
COLOR — an unforgettable, saturated, perfectly controlled color story that makes the image pop like a vintage Kodachrome magazine spread.
SET DESIGN — the room is a maximalist masterpiece of 1950s holiday styling, every corner obsessively art-directed.
PROPS — the props are oversized, abundant and central to the action, with the couple physically interacting with them.
SCALE — play with scale: gigantic gifts, towering trees, enormous bows or a vast room that dwarfs the couple for a playful, surreal-yet-plausible effect.
TEXTURE — tactile richness everywhere: flocking, tinsel, glass ornaments, knit, wood grain, frosting, crinkled paper, all in hyper-detailed focus.
SURREALISM — a subtle dreamlike twist (impossible abundance, gravity-defying ribbons, snow falling indoors) that still obeys photographic physics in light, shadow and contact.
EXPRESSION — the faces are everything: authentic, readable, emotionally rich expressions that tell the story at a glance.
ENVIRONMENTAL INTERACTION — the couple actively uses the space: leaning, climbing, sitting on, reaching into and rearranging the décor around them.
